name: FalkorDB
tier_reason: RedisGraph successor lineage; GraphRAG-oriented candidate backend; SSPL licence is a legal-review trigger
latest_version: v6.0.3 (Rust engine line, Redis 8.10.2 base); v4.22.2 (C engine line)
release_cadence: Weekly-to-biweekly patch releases on two parallel lines (v6.0.1 2026-10-01, v6.0.2 10-08, v4.22.1 10-15, v4.22.2 10-20, v6.0.3 10-22)
license: Core: SSPLv1; bundled Redis/RediSearch: RSALv2, SSPLv1 or AGPLv3 (choose-one); GraphBLAS Apache-2.0; MCP server MIT (third-party listing); GraphRAG SDK licence not stated on docs page
redistribution_notes: Vendor FAQ: internal use and redistribution inside an application not offered as a service need no source disclosure; offering it as a service requires open-sourcing the associated codebase or a commercial licence; OEM/embedding terms are undefined and need vendor contact.
legal_review_reason: SSPLv1 service-offering clause vs white-label SaaS/managed hosting; bundled Redis 8 tri-licence; undefined OEM terms; SDK/MCP licences differ per repo
community_vs_enterprise: Self-hosted source-available core; FalkorDB Cloud managed and commercial licence for avoiding SSPL obligations; feature split not itemised
resolution_note: RedisGraph EOL 2023-07-05, support ended 2025-01-31; FalkorDB is the direct successor (same GRAPH.* API, reads RedisGraph RDB). v6 replaces the C query engine with a Rust engine; 4.x and 6.0 nodes cannot share a replica set.
action_reason: User-named; successor lineage; optional backend and pattern source
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT as customer-supplied optional backend (never bundled); REUSE graph-per-tenant isolation pattern; DEFER native vector; REJECT GraphRAG SDK as dependency; legal review before any bundling

name: TigerGraph
tier_reason: Direct enterprise graph competitor (distributed analytics, GSQL, vector and GraphRAG)
release_cadence: 4.2.x LTS maintenance roughly every 1-3 months; 4.3 release candidates 2026-07-08 and 2026-10-20
license: Enterprise: commercial licence; Community Edition: proprietary community licence (agreement updated 2026-03-05); GraphRAG repo AGPL-3.0 since v2.0.1 (Apache-2.0 before)
redistribution_notes: Community licence is internal-use only, revocable, bars third-party use, distribution/derivatives and benchmark publication, 300 GB combined graph+vector, no support; Enterprise OEM terms NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED.
legal_review_reason: Community Edition barred for white-label/third-party use and redistribution; benchmark-publication prohibition; AGPL-3.0 GraphRAG; Enterprise OEM terms unknown
community_vs_enterprise: Community: single server, 300 GB combined graph+vector (200+100 GB at 4.2.0), 4096-dim vectors, community support only, some enterprise features excluded; Enterprise: cluster, HA, CRR, 32768-dim vectors, support
resolution_note: CoPilot renamed GraphRAG in the repo (docs still say CoPilot); Savanna replaced TG Cloud Classic; 100x/108TB benchmark claims are vendor-tuned or unaudited.
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT as customer-licensed optional backend only; BUILD accumulator/aggregate operator and row-policy-style ACL natively; REJECT embedding GraphRAG (AGPL, single DB) and CE bundling

sources.title: TigerGraph: A Native MPP Graph Database

name: JanusGraph
tier_reason: Backend EOIP already has an adapter for (adapters/janusgraph.py); Apache-2.0 distributed OLTP reference
owner: JanusGraph community under Linux Foundation (LF AI & Data)
release_cadence: About one stable release per year; 23-month gap between 1.1.0 and the 1.2.0 pre-release (published 2026-10-25, notes dated 2026-10-28)
license: Apache License 2.0 (docs CC-BY-4.0); no commercial edition
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0, redistribution-safe; risk lies in optional dependencies (BerkeleyDB JE, Elasticsearch, ScyllaDB editions) which need separate review.
legal_review_reason: Core is Apache-2.0; dependency licences (BerkeleyDB JE, Elasticsearch, Scylla) are UNVERIFIED and should be checked if bundled
community_vs_enterprise: No split; all functionality free; no vendor support
resolution_note: Titan lineage; 1.2.0 is a GitHub pre-release with a notes/publish date mismatch; TinkerPop 3.8 changes Gremlin semantics so the EOIP adapter must be retested before pinning 1.2.x.
action_reason: Existing EOIP adapter; Apache-2.0 backend option
decision_summary: INTEGRATE existing adapter after fixes (key prefix mismatch, index provisioning, binding labels/keys, batching); BUILD tenancy/ACL in EOIP layer; REUSE backend durability and scale-out

name: RedisGraph (historical)
latest_version: UNVERIFIED (Redis Software 7.4.6 notes list bundled v2.10)
release_cadence: none; maintenance mode until 2024-12-31, deprecated tag 2025-02-01
redistribution_notes: Not applicable; unmaintained. Successor FalkorDB is SSPLv1.
community_vs_enterprise: Formerly part of Redis Enterprise and Redis Stack; removed from Redis Stack 7.2.x
resolution_note: EOL announced 2023-07-05; end of support 2025-01-31; FalkorDB is the successor lineage (Master Prompt trap 6 resolved).
decision_summary: REFERENCE-ONLY; no adapter; point to FalkorDB
